contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ L SE[---EG?] IMP VIII ; R/ FORTVNA[---]

Silver coin. Denarius of Septimius Severus (193-211), issue of 196-197, cf. RIC volume 4 part 1 no. 78a. Obverse description: Bust laureate right. Obverse inscription: L SE[---EG?] IMP VIII. Reverse description: Fortuna seated left holding cornucopiae and pointer to rudder and globe left. Reverse inscription: FORTVNA[---]. Diameter: 17.3mm, Weight: 2.91gms, die axis: 12
